description: This Java class defines a GUI menu bar for a table interface in the RomRaider project, including menus for file operations, editing, viewing, and comparison features.

classes.name: TableMenuBar
classes.description: A menu bar class for managing table-related actions in the RomRaider GUI.

methods.name: initFileMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'File' menu with options like view graph, compare, and close table.

methods.name: initEditMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'Edit' menu with options for undo, revert, copy, paste, and interpolation.

methods.name: initViewMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'View' menu with table properties.

methods.name: initCompareMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'Compare' menu with options for different comparison modes.

methods.name: initCompareGroup
methods.description: Sets up the button group for comparison options.

methods.name: applyTableTypeRules
methods.description: Disables certain menu options if the table type is a switch type.
